system.description:
Replace «Reactive Heal» with this skill at CR11 or higher. Target a character who has just received HP Damage from an attack. The target recovers +[Magic Power] HP. This skill may only be used once in response to a single attack.

(Hate Top): You may reduce the [Hate] cost of this skill to 0.

Magic that responds to an enemy's attack and heals allies' recent injuries. By using higher-level techniques, you can exert a steady healing power.
